sql_reading_A.sql:
SELECT
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    VAR_POP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units
FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY
WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU'
GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;

sql_reading_B.sql:
SELECT
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    VAR_SAMP(TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units
FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY
WHERE TERM_CODE = '2012SU'
GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME;
